given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner enters an incorrect secondary verification code while the total count of consecutive failures is below the system threshold
given_when_then.when: The system validates the primary credential and secondary code against the Customer Profile
given_when_then.then: Access is denied but the session remains unlocked, allowing another attempt within the time window

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner enters an incorrect secondary verification code while the total count of consecutive failures equals the system threshold
given_when_then.when: The system validates the primary credential and secondary code against the Customer Profile
given_when_then.then: Access is denied and the session is locked immediately to prevent further attempts

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner enters an incorrect secondary verification code within the allowed time window
given_when_then.when: The secondary verification code expires before the system confirms a valid match
given_when_then.then: Access is denied and the session is locked to prevent reuse of the expired code

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner enters the correct secondary verification code
given_when_then.when: The system validates the primary credential and secondary code against the Customer Profile
given_when_then.then: Access is granted and the session is unlocked

success_criteria: The system denies access and locks the session only when the number of consecutive authentication failures exceeds the system threshold following a secondary code failure.
The system denies access without locking the session when a secondary code fails but the consecutive failure count remains at or below the threshold.
The system denies access and locks the session if the secondary verification code expires before a valid match is confirmed.
The system grants access when the primary credential and secondary verification code both validate successfully within the defined time window.
